sentences.chinese: 五月的机票比八月的机票贵。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔ yuè de jīpiào bǐ bā yuè de jīpiào guì.
sentences.english_hint: May flights cost more than August flights.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you are postponing your China trip.
sentences.source_note: Repeatedly added 很 to 比 comparisons; corrected using May and August ticket prices.

sentences.chinese: 这个手机比那个手机贵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī bǐ nàge shǒujī guì.
sentences.english_hint: This phone costs more than that one.
sentences.source_note: Phone prices were used to clarify 比 versus 比较; reinforces comparison without 很.

sentences.pinyin: Bā yuè de jīpiào bǐjiào piányi.
sentences.scenario: Explain the advantage of traveling in August.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 比较更便宜 by using 比较 alone.

sentences.pinyin: Bā yuè de jīpiào gèng piányi.
sentences.scenario: After discussing May prices, mention August prices.
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes 更便宜 from 比较便宜 and prohibits combining 比较更.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng qūfēn zhèxiē Hànzì.
sentences.scenario: Tell your teacher which reading task is difficult.
sentences.source_note: Corrects recurring 不可以 for inability and 汉字们 for object plurals.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge Hànzì hěn nán.
sentences.scenario: Point out a small group of difficult characters.
sentences.source_note: Teacher supplied 这几个汉字 as a replacement for 汉字们.

sentences.chinese: 一张机票要一千二百美元。
sentences.pinyin: Yì zhāng jīpiào yào yì qiān èr bǎi měiyuán.
sentences.english_hint: One ticket costs twelve hundred dollars.
sentences.scenario: Tell your family the May ticket price discussed in class.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 一个机票 was corrected to 一张机票; learner clarified the price as twelve hundred dollars.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng xiān dāi zài jiālǐ.
sentences.english_hint: I've decided to stay home for now.
sentences.source_note: Learner repeatedly struggled to produce the corrected chunk 决定先待在家里.

sentences.chinese: 我的决定是八月再去中国旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de juédìng shì bā yuè zài qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
sentences.english_hint: My decision is to wait until August to visit China.
sentences.scenario: State when you have decided to travel.
sentences.source_note: Explicit noun-form correction; learner confused 再 with 在 while restating the August plan.

sentences.scenario: Answer when someone offers coffee or tea.
sentences.source_note: Learner's coffee preference was corrected from 比较有咖啡 to 比较喜欢喝咖啡.

sentences.chinese: 开会以前必须把文件准备好。
sentences.pinyin: Kāihuì yǐqián bìxū bǎ wénjiàn zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: The documents must be ready before the meeting.
sentences.scenario: State what must be done before a work meeting.
sentences.source_note: Core lesson drill combined 必须 with 把文件准备好; learner repeatedly needed help producing it.

sentences.chinese: 客户要把预算减百分之十。
sentences.pinyin: Kèhù yào bǎ yùsuàn jiǎn bǎi fēn zhī shí.
sentences.english_hint: The client wants to cut the budget by ten percent.
sentences.scenario: Relay the client's request in the lesson's work exercise.
sentences.source_note: Successfully practiced the lesson's specific 把预算减百分之十 pattern.

sentences.chinese: 我的旅游预算必须减少。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de lǚyóu yùsuàn bìxū jiǎnshǎo.
sentences.english_hint: My travel budget has to decrease.
sentences.scenario: Explain a constraint on your travel plans.
sentences.source_note: Personal travel-budget context; learner repeatedly misplaced 把 while producing 必须减少.

sentences.english_hint: I don't need to work overtime on weekends.
sentences.source_note: Learner confirmed no weekend overtime; corrected 不需 to 不需要 and practiced fourth-tone 末.
